tasks.title: Inside a jamming field the player cannot fire H abilities or K rockets, and gets them back a moment after leaving; movement, boost, dash and the main gun never change
tasks.description: Build the player-side ability lock before any enemy uses it. PlayerBase (global/entities/player_base.gd) gains ability_lock_changed(locked: bool), ability_press_refused(), apply_ability_lock(seconds, source), abilities_locked(), ability_lock_fill(), allow_ability_press() and a _step_ability_lock(delta) called at the top of _step_disruption(). Every lock clock follows the 1e-6 rule (x -= delta, over at x <= 1e-6), so a 1.5 s lock ends on tick 90 exactly. The field is sampled by the body: HazardInfo gains stabilise_seconds, HazardField gains exports disables_abilities (true only while ACTIVE) and stabilise_seconds, Hazards gains jammer_at(pos). One allow_ability_press() check goes into each of the three seams: OpenSpacePlayerShip._input, PlayerFighter._input and RocketState._on_action (special_weapon only, after the cooldown check, before launch and cooldown start). WeaponState is not edited. Tests first: tests/integration/test_player_ability_lock.gd on both real player scenes plus the jammer_at rows in tests/unit/test_hazards.gd, using a plain HazardField as the jammer.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All rows of plan §2.2 pass in both real player scenes: lock on the first tick inside; unlocked exactly at T+45 after a 0.75 s exit (locked at T+44); re-entry restarts the delay; pulsed TELEGRAPH/QUIET count as outside; a freed field starts the delay; timed locks longest-wins with no stabilisation, a 1.5 s lock unlocked after exactly 90 ticks (and the epsilon boundary row); every H module and both K rocket types refused while locked with nothing spent and the event handled; switch_weapon still works; module cooldowns keep ticking; primary fire for all five weapon modes and movement verbs bit-identical inside a lit field; with Hazards.count() == 0 the lock state, fill and signals are untouched over 120 ticks and every press goes through (observable assertions; Hazards is static and cannot be spied). Every existing player, hazard and module test unchanged and green. GUT delta reported (allotment 2.0 s). verify.sh green.

tasks.title: A homing rocket can be taken over: it flashes amber, turns slowly back toward the player and bursts for a small blast, can be shot down or lured into an enemy, and flies straight inside a jammer
tasks.description: Build the seeking-ordnance retarget contract and the hijacked flight mode, pinned with a fixture claimer before any Hacker exists. New global/components/seeking_ordnance.gd (SeekingOrdnance.GROUP, eligible()). homing_missile joins the group and implements can_be_retargeted(), retarget(target, seconds, source) (seconds < 0 uses its own hijack_seconds), is_retargeted(), jam_guidance(source), signals retargeted(source: Node) and retarget_ended(); emits EventBus.player_ordnance_hijacked. Hijacked flight: turn-limited Steering.turn_toward at hijack_turn_rate 1.6, speed eases to 380, 2.5 s window then fizzle, ContactBlast-only player damage (18, r 40) after arming (0.25 s and 60 px clearance), full damage to enemies, a shoot-down HurtBox (512/64) enabled only while hijacked, a self-hit guard (the HitBox ignores any area whose parent is a homing_missile, so the rocket never hits its own HurtBox or salvo-mates and player rockets never shoot each other down; warhead_missile.gd::_on_hit_box_area_entered gets the same guard, because a warhead's HitBox is also mask 513 and would otherwise die on a hijacked rocket's HurtBox), one _finish(blasted) end of life that every end goes through including the ProjectileLifetime expiry (so retarget_ended always fires), the 0.3 s tether flash drawn by the rocket itself, fizzle at once when the source is freed, amber tell and target bracket. Seekers inside a lit jammer field (Hazards.jammer_at) fly straight, hijacked or not. All tuning as exports on homing_missile.tscn. Tests in tests/integration/test_seeking_ordnance.gd, both harnesses, blast rows on both real player scenes.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All rows of plan §2.5 pass: group and refusals (warheads never eligible), per-tick turn bounded by hijack_turn_rate, speed 500 to 380, exactly 18 blast damage and never 100, arming rule, fizzle at 2.5 s with no blast, source death fizzles, the lure deals 100 to an enemy, one bullet shoots it down, jammed rockets fly straight, the Open Space and Assault dodge rows (with a stationary control that is hit), primary fire bit-identical during a hijack, EventBus emit once per claim; the real-physics self-hit rows (a claimed rocket in a real 7 px salvo and its salvo-mates all alive 2, 10 and 30 ticks after the claim); the warhead-guard row (a real warhead flown through a hijacked homing rocket: both alive, fails without the guard); the lifetime-ends-a-hijack row (a rocket kept alive 5.0 s by hovering on a hurtbox-less static Node2D, then claimed: expires 1.0 s later with retarget_ended once, no blast); the tether row.
